concerns.text: Task T006 (Implement pipeline/model.py with GPT checkpoint loading) is marked as DEPENDS ON T005a. However, T005a (Implement dataset loaders) is currently marked as unchecked (not started), while T006 is marked as checked (completed). This creates a logical impossibility: a consumer task (T006) is marked complete before its producer (T005a) is complete. T005a must be completed before T006 can be validly executed.

Task T010 (Implement pipeline/evaluator.py) is marked as [P] (parallel-safe) and unchecked. Task T010b (Implement GSM8K/ARC/BoolQ evaluation logic) is marked as [P] and unchecked, with a dependency on T010. However, T010b is a specific implementation detail of T010. If T010 is the 'runner' and T010b is the 'logic', T010b should likely precede T010 or be merged. More critically, T010 is marked [P] but depends on T005a (dataset loaders). If T005a is not complete, T010 cannot be parallel-safe or complete. The dependency chain T005a -> T010 -> T010b is broken by the current status flags.

Task T059b (Implement Fixed-Point Oracle) is marked as [P] and depends on T010b. T010b depends on T010, which depends on T005a. T005a is unchecked. T059b is marked as checked (completed). This is a severe ordering violation: a task (T059b) that consumes the output of a chain starting with an incomplete task (T005a) is marked as complete. The 'Fixed-Point Oracle' cannot be implemented without the evaluation logic (T010b) which requires the dataset loaders (T005a).

Task T059a (Implement Pre-Application External Oracle Check) is marked as [P] and depends on T013. T013 (Define modification proposal JSON schema) is unchecked. T059a is marked as checked. A task validating proposals against a schema (T059a) cannot be complete if the schema definition (T013) is not yet complete.

Task T037 (Implement 'Separation of Generative/Verification Logic' prompt template) is marked as [P] and depends on T013 and T006. T013 is unchecked. T006 is checked. T037 is checked. The dependency on T013 (schema definition) is violated; the prompt template cannot be finalized without the schema it is supposed to enforce.

Task T015 (Implement pipeline/model.py method to parse proposal) depends on T013, T006, and T037. T013 is unchecked. T037 is checked. T015 is unchecked. While T015 is correctly unchecked, the dependency on T013 (unchecked) means T015 cannot proceed. The status of T013 must be resolved before T015 can be started.

Task T020 (Implement main.py::run_single_cycle) depends on T013, T014, T008, T007, T010b, T017a, T018, T019, T044, T036, T037b, T059a, T059b. T013 is unchecked. T014 is unchecked. T008 is unchecked. T010b is unchecked. T017a is unchecked. T018 is unchecked. T019 is unchecked. T037b is unchecked. T059a is checked. T059b is checked. The task T020 is the orchestrator for the entire cycle. It depends on a large number of unchecked foundational tasks (T013, T014, T008, T010b, etc.). Marking T059a and T059b as complete while their dependencies (T013, T010b) are incomplete is a critical ordering failure.

Task T025 (Implement main.py loop logic) depends on T013, T029, T014, T020, T044, T036, T026, T059a, T059b. T013 is unchecked. T014 is unchecked. T020 is unchecked. T026 is unchecked. T025 is unchecked. The dependency on T020 (single cycle) and T013 (schema) is clear. The status of T013 and T014 must be resolved before T025 can be considered.

Task T031 (Implement stats.py logic for trade-off) depends on T030 and T048. T030 depends on T017b. T017b is unchecked. T048 depends on T004. T004 is checked. T031 is unchecked. The chain is T004 -> T048 -> T031 -> T030 -> T017b. T017b is unchecked, blocking T030, which blocks T031. This is a valid dependency chain, but the status of T017b must be addressed.

Tasks T062, T063, T064, T065 are marked as [P] and unchecked. They depend on T029, T031, T010b, T017b, T010b, T029, T031. T029 is unchecked. T031 is unchecked. T010b is unchecked. T017b is unchecked. These tasks are correctly unchecked, but their dependencies (T029, T031, T010b, T017b) are also unchecked, creating a blockage. The status of T013, T014, T008, T010b, T017b, T029, T031 must be resolved to unblock Phase 6.
